entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait for the next available agent.
Hi, you've reached VeloFit, my name is Diana. How can I help you today?
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have the order number handy?
Yeah, it's VF8675309. For the VeloBand Cadence Sensor.
Thank you. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see the order. It looks like it was delivered about three weeks ago, on December 15th.
Yes, I'm aware. I had an unforeseen emergency and ended up in the hospital.
Oh, I'm very sorry to hear that. I hope everything is alright. Just for my notes here, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's a preference. The surgery kind of changed my fitness plans for the foreseeable future. Not that it matters.
I understand completely, and I do apologize for your troubles. Let me just check the return eligibility for you. Please hold for one moment.
Thanks for waiting. I've just reviewed your order against our return policy, and you're well within the 90-day return window.
Oh. Really? I was expecting a problem.
Not at all. We can definitely get that processed for you. I'm sending the return instructions and a prepaid shipping label to the email address on file right now. You should receive it shortly.
Fine. Whatever. Guess I didn't need to explain the whole hospital emergency then.
Well, we're just happy we could get this sorted out for you. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope you have a speedy recovery.
